description: This is a Go source file implementing a command-line tool for translating documentation files with support for multiple modes (document or segment), parallel processing, and translation memory management.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point of the command-line translation utility, parsing flags and coordinating translation modes.

methods.name: runDocSequential
methods.description: Processes documentation files sequentially in 'doc' mode.

methods.name: runDocParallel
methods.description: Processes documentation files in parallel in 'doc' mode using worker goroutines.

methods.name: runSegmentSequential
methods.description: Processes files sequentially in 'segment' translation mode, translating by segments.

methods.name: resolveRelPath
methods.description: Resolves and returns the relative path of a file within the docs root.

methods.name: filterDocQueue
methods.description: Filters the list of files to process based on whether they require re-translation.
